common.note: All modes use the W8A16 drafter view (mtp/mtp-draft-e4m3.safetensors, shipped in the checkpoint repo). Default modes decode / prefill-long run W8A8 prompt rows on the native GDN prefill path; the -nopf modes drop the two native-prefill flags (exact-arithmetic prefill, about 7 % slower). Numbers in README.md / BENCHMARKS.md were measured on the shipped image through launch-flashnext.py.

prefix_caching.note: opt-in (launcher --prefix-caching): align-mode prefix caching on the recurrent state; the attention block is set explicitly to 2048 (--block-size 2048) = the mamba block, so a prefix hit resumes on a block boundary and is bit-identical to a cold start (without it vLLM picks 1696 and hits differ from cold; checked 12 Oct 2026); served gates 10 Oct 2026: 64K repeat 9.6 s -> 0.35 s TTFT with identical output; needles 131K + 200K 40/40

host_pools.note: HSA_USERPTR_FOR_PAGED_MEM=0: ROCm allocates the host tables as GTT buffers instead of registered user pointers, so host memory compaction no longer invalidates them (KFD eviction stalls under load 2.7 s -> 0.07 s over a 3-minute run at 8 requests, speed unchanged). They count against the first GPU's GTT size: 56,116 MiB above the idle baseline at ready (decode mode, 10 Oct).
host_pools.note_3bit: 3-bit modes default to ROCm user-pointer pools (the published 10 Oct behaviour and VRAM peaks); --host-pools gtt is their opt-in: it removes the occasional memory pauses under load and costs ~1 GiB VRAM in decode (rel3s vs rel3u, 12 Oct)

ple_host.note: opt-in (launcher --ple-host pageable, 4-bit modes 4bit and 4bit-cache): the per-layer embedding (PLE) tables (24.44 GiB per rank, E4M3) stay in ordinary pageable host memory (anonymous mmap, transparent huge pages, mlocked when RLIMIT_MEMLOCK allows) instead of pinned GTT memory; the GPU's gathers go through a host worker pool. Pinned host memory 95.5 -> 46.6 GiB (GTT at ready, 13 Oct), so the GTT pools fit the default GTT limit (half the RAM) of a 128 GB host; the RAM need is unchanged. Gate 13 Oct under a 118 GiB container memory limit: 4bit C1 176.2 / C8 403.4 (pinned 177.2 / 400.7), 4bit-cache 159.0 / 323.3 (pinned 157.0 / 324.7), output bit-identical. Needs an image with the pageable PLE runtime (images); the published 4-bit image keeps the tables pinned.

filebacked.note: opt-in (launcher --ple-host filebacked; auto on modes marked ple_filebacked when MemAvailable cannot keep the PLE tables resident): the E4M3 PLE export laid out once as two raw files next to the weights (<weights>-ple-raw: codes.e4m3 + row_scale.f32, ~50 GB) and mmapped read-only by each rank, so the tables live in the page cache (shared, evictable, read from disk on a miss) instead of resident process memory; the same host gather as pageable, so the output is the same. Needs an image with the file-backed runtime (images).

common.kv_pool_note: kv_pool_tokens: vLLM "GPU KV cache size" at the mode's --kv-cache-memory-bytes on the release image (11-12 Oct); the -nopf modes and 4bit-cache share their base mode's KV bytes; the launcher scales it linearly when --kv-cache-memory-bytes is lowered
common.response_parsers_note: Every mode passes --reasoning-parser qwen3 (the chat template opens <think> in the prompt unless enable_thinking is false: the thinking goes to the reasoning field of the response message (delta.reasoning when streamed), the answer to content) and --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml (the template's <tool_call><function=...><parameter=...> format -> tool_calls). vLLM 0.29 parser checked on the CPU against this tokenizer and template, 13 Oct 2026.

decode-nopf.note: RC8-a8 without the two native-GDN-prefill flags: exact-arithmetic prefill on prompt rows (our long-document control: the native path is not bit-reproducible run to run, the exact path is); prefill on this path measured 7,607 @64K (W8A8) / 7,368 (W8A16)

4bit-cache.note: opt-in cache mode for agents and coding tools: --mode 4bit with prefix caching (align, 2,048-token blocks) and an 8 GiB RAM prefix tier (gates 12 Oct, exact). Repeated long prompts start in ~1 s instead of 6-16 s (32K 6.3 -> 1.0 s, 64K 12.3 -> 1.1 s, 90K 16.2 -> 1.1 s, identical output); @8 321.4 tok/s (-22 % vs the 4bit default 411.3 in-engine), C1 146.7, TTFT on fresh prompts +0.1-0.2 s; peak 30.3 GiB per card; first-GPU GTT ~106 GiB with the tier: the full tier needs ~108 GiB free GTT
